### `Layout`

A layout (spec 12 §12.5.1).

One of:

- object {`direction`, `gap`, `align`, `justify`, `padding`, `wrap`, `children`, `box`, `type`}: Figma-style auto layout.
- object {`columns`, `rows`, `gap`, `cell`, `align`, `box`, `children`, `padding`, `type`}: Grid.
- object {`radius`, `startAngle`, `sweep`, `center`, `orient`, `children`, `type`}: Around an arc.
- object {`path`, `spacing`, `orient`, `children`, `type`}: Along a path.
